1.content: Dark clouds spill ink, yet leave the hills in sight; white raindrops leap like pearls into the boat.
1.author: Su Shi · Rain at the Lake

2.content: A time will come to ride the wind and waves, and set my sail across the open sea.
2.author: Li Bai · The Hard Road

3.content: The sunset cloud and lone wild duck fly together; autumn water and vast sky share one hue.
3.author: Wang Bo · Preface to the Pavilion

4.content: Where mountains and rivers seem to end the road, a village appears among willows and blossoms.
4.author: Lu You · Visiting a Village

goldLoop.title: Golden Spin
goldLoop.seoDescription: Watch Fibonacci squares and quarter-circle arcs gradually form a spiral.
goldLoop.ariaLabel: Fibonacci squares and arcs are drawn in sequence to approximate a golden spiral
goldLoop.explanation: Squares with Fibonacci side lengths are arranged in sequence, then a quarter-circle arc is drawn inside each one. This is a common approximation of a golden spiral, not the exact curve described by the formula.
